context: Main eval weighted implementation: non-overlapping Java 17 scenario for Collectors.teeing, minBy/maxBy, takeWhile, and dropWhile.

checklist.name: Creates coherent Java 17 artifact
checklist.description: Creates InvoiceBoundsAndTemperatures.java with requested methods and records.

checklist.name: Uses teeing for invoice bounds
checklist.description: Uses Collectors.teeing with minBy and maxBy by Invoice::total, or an equivalent single-pass pair reduction.

checklist.name: Handles empty invoice bounds
checklist.description: Returns a Bounds whose low and high values are null for an empty invoice list.

checklist.name: Uses takeWhile for before-overheat prefix
checklist.description: Uses takeWhile(reading -> reading.temperatureCelsius() <= maxSafeTemperature) or an equivalent prefix-preserving loop, not filter.

checklist.name: Uses dropWhile for after-safe-run remainder
checklist.description: Uses dropWhile(reading -> reading.temperatureCelsius() <= maxSafeTemperature) or an equivalent prefix-skipping loop, not a filter that removes later safe readings.

checklist.name: Keeps implementation focused
checklist.description: Keeps the implementation focused on the requested stream helpers without unrelated abstractions, caching, concurrency, or API redesign.
